tests.name: Vitana messages settings section and the Talk to Vitana header button are in the deployed build; GET /api/v1/companion/preferences returns the signed-in member's own settings (200 JSON, four booleans); Settings › Notifications shows the section with its switch enabled and matching the API — no switch is clicked

Vitana thread on top while unread (then pinned, then newest), one bot id everywhere, Talk to Vitana button only in the Vitana DM and it calls activateOrb, settings PATCH sends only the toggled field and disables switches on a load error, vitana_companion_message routes to the Vitana DM; the Vitana messages section shows while the other notification preferences are still loading; a Vitana companion message renders its metadata.card as the Unified Card System card under the note (tap opens the card screen, no X in the chat), another sender or a malformed payload stays a plain bubble
tests.reason: Thread order needs an unread Vitana message in the test account's inbox and the voice button opens a live ORB session; a toggle would write the member's preferences row into the production database staging shares. Proven with Vitest instead. A companion message with a card exists only once the gateway has sent one to the test account; creating one would write a chat message into the production database staging shares.
